description: This file defines the MBRelationship class, which acts as an adapter for managing module relationships within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder framework. It handles adding, deleting, retrieving, and saving relationships, interfacing with underlying relationship classes, and maintaining internal state of relationships.

classes.name: MBRelationship
classes.description: An adapter class for managing module relationships in SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, providing methods to add, delete, retrieve, and save relationships by delegating to the underlying UndeployedRelationships implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MBRelationship instance with module name, path, and key name, setting up the underlying relationships handler.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Finds modules that can be related to the current module via the underlying implementation.

methods.name: addFromPost
methods.description: Adds a new relationship based on POST data, delegating to the underlying implementation.

methods.name: getRelationshipList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of current relationships from the implementation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relationship by name.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship definition, converting old formats if necessary, and updating internal state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of relationships.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds relationship files in the specified path.

methods.name: updateRelationshipVariable
methods.description: Keeps the internal relationships array in sync with the implementation's relationship list.
